# 江山时序 (Jiangshan Historical Atlas of China)

> Interactive historical atlas timeline of China from the Warring States (403 BCE) to the present (2026 CE), featuring dynastic territories, administrative divisions (zhou/jun/fu/dao/lu/sheng), ancient-to-modern place genealogy, strategic passes, and historical journeys.

- Live URL: https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/
- Repository: https://github.com/DeanChensj/jiangshan-map

## 1. AI Deep-Link URL Protocol (Zero-Backend Spatiotemporal Linking)

When a user asks about a historical event, classical poem, battle, or ancient place (e.g. *"雪拥蓝关马不前 当时是什么时间地点"*), resolve the historical year and location yourself, then return a direct deep link using the 5 supported query parameters:

```text
https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/?year=<YEAR>&place=<PLACE>&lng=<LNG>&lat=<LAT>&zoom=<ZOOM>
```

### Query Parameters (5 Parameters Only)
- `year` (integer, `-403` to `2026`, no year `0`): Historical year. Negative numbers represent BCE (e.g., `-221` = 221 BCE, `819` = 819 CE).
- `place` (string, optional): Ancient or modern place name to highlight on the map pin and genealogy card (e.g., `蓝田关`, `长安`, `赤壁`, `黄州`). If `lng`/`lat` are omitted, the atlas automatically resolves `place` against its built-in settlements, strategic passes, prefectures, and provinces.
- `lng` (float, optional): Longitude in decimal degrees (`70.0` to `142.0`). Provide alongside `lat` for exact pinpoint placement (especially for poetic sites, mountain passes, or battlefields not in the default city list).
- `lat` (float, optional): Latitude in decimal degrees (`15.0` to `56.0`).
- `zoom` (float, optional, `1.0` to `8.0`, default `2.5`): Camera zoom level (`1.8` = macro region, `2.6` = prefecture/pass closeup, `3.5+` = local city detail).

### Canonical Deep-Link Examples
- **韩愈《左迁至蓝关示侄孙湘》("雪拥蓝关马不前", 唐宪宗元和十四年 / 819 CE, 蓝田关)**:
  https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/?year=819&place=蓝田关&lng=109.48&lat=34.03&zoom=2.6
- **苏轼《念奴娇·赤壁怀古》(宋神宗元丰五年 / 1082 CE, 黄州赤鼻矶)**:
  https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/?year=1082&place=黄州&lng=114.88&lat=30.45&zoom=2.6
- **赤壁之战 (东汉建安十三年 / 208 CE, 赤壁)**:
  https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/?year=208&place=赤壁&lng=113.90&lat=29.88&zoom=2.6
- **秦灭六国一统天下 (秦始皇二十六年 / 221 BCE, 咸阳)**:
  https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/?year=-221&place=咸阳&zoom=2.3

## 2. Browser JavaScript API (`window.atlasAPI`)

For browser agents, Playwright scripts, or WebMCP integrations interacting with a live page instance:

- `window.atlasAPI.locate({ year, place, lng, lat, zoom })`:
  Jumps the timeline to `year`, centers/zooms the map camera on `(lng, lat)` (or resolves `place` automatically), drops a labeled pin on the canvas, opens the 2,000-year administrative genealogy card (`#genealogy-card`), and returns the structured inspection object.
- `window.atlasAPI.resolvePlace(place, year?)`:
  Resolves an ancient/modern city, strategic pass, prefecture, or province name to `{ kind, name, modern, lng, lat, coord, zoom }` (or `null` if not found).
- `window.atlasAPI.inspect({ year, place, lng, lat, zoom })`:
  Read-only query that returns the historical context at `(year, place / lng, lat)` without moving the camera:
  `{ year, era, dynasty, place, coord, zoom, polity, regions, prefectures, modernProvince, nearestCity, url }`.

## 3. Dynasty Timeline Coverage (`-403` to `2026`)

| Key | Period (ZH / EN) | Year Span | Capital / Seat |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `zhanguo` | 战国 / Warring States | `-403` to `-222` | 洛阳(周王畿) · 七雄并立 |
| `qin` | 秦 / Qin | `-221` to `-202` | 咸阳 (今陕西咸阳东北) |
| `xihan` | 西汉 / Western Han | `-201` to `8` | 长安 (今陕西西安) |
| `donghan` | 新朝 · 东汉 / Xin & Eastern Han | `9` to `220` | 洛阳 (今河南洛阳) |
| `sanguo` | 三国 / Three Kingdoms | `221` to `265` | 洛阳(魏) · 成都(蜀) · 建业(吴) |
| `xijin` | 西晋 / Western Jin | `266` to `316` | 洛阳 (今河南洛阳) |
| `dongjin` | 东晋十六国 / Eastern Jin & Sixteen Kingdoms | `317` to `419` | 建康 (今江苏南京) |
| `nanbeichao` | 南北朝 / Northern & Southern Dynasties | `420` to `580` | 建康(南朝) · 平城/洛阳/邺城/长安(北朝) |
| `sui` | 隋 / Sui | `581` to `617` | 大兴 (今陕西西安) · 东都洛阳 |
| `tang` | 唐 / Tang | `618` to `906` | 长安 (今陕西西安) · 东都洛阳 |
| `wudai` | 五代十国 / Five Dynasties & Ten Kingdoms | `907` to `959` | 汴州(开封) · 洛阳 |
| `beisong` | 北宋 · 辽 · 西夏 / Northern Song, Liao & Xixia | `960` to `1126` | 东京开封府 (今河南开封) |
| `nansong` | 南宋 · 金 · 西夏 / Southern Song, Jin & Xixia | `1127` to `1270` | 临安府 (今浙江杭州) · 金中都(今北京) |
| `yuan` | 元 / Yuan | `1271` to `1367` | 大都 (今北京) · 上都(今正蓝旗) |
| `ming` | 明 / Ming | `1368` to `1643` | 应天府(南京) → 顺天府(北京) |
| `qing` | 清 / Qing | `1644` to `1911` | 京师顺天府 (今北京) |
| `roc` | 中华民国 / Republic of China | `1912` to `1948` | 北京(北洋) · 南京(国民政府) · 重庆(陪都) |
| `prc` | 现代中国 / Modern China | `1949` to `2026` | 北京 |
